title: Special repairs & maintenance work at Kelshi Lighthouse Station
summary: Percentage-rate e-tender for special repairs and maintenance at Kelshi Lighthouse, Anjarle, Ratnagiri district, Maharashtra: scaffolding, repainting of lighthouse tower inside and out, concrete repairs, waterproofing, uPVC windows, paver-block relaying, plumbing and door/window fittings.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

sites.name: Kelshi Lighthouse, P.O. Anjarle, Dist. Ratnagiri, Maharashtra, Pin-415714
sites.work: Special repairs and maintenance of lighthouse tower and premises

scope.item: Double cup-lock scaffolding on exterior, all heights
Removing old distemper/enamel/cement paint from interior and exterior walls of lighthouse tower, doors, windows
White cement based putty 1 mm on interior of lighthouse tower
Water thinnable cement primer (VOC < 50 g/l)
Synthetic enamel paint on interior and exterior walls of lighthouse tower
French spirit polishing on woodwork
FRP chajja 4 mm (RTM technology)
uPVC two-track two-panel sliding windows, R4 series, multi-point locking
PU sealant filling of frame gaps
Clearing jungle and vegetation
Dismantling doors/windows (3 sqm and below)
Dismantling tile work in floors and roofs
Chipping unsound concrete from slabs, beams, columns (50 mm)
Cleaning rust from reinforcement bars up to 12 mm
Hard drawn steel wire fabric 75x25 mm anchored to concrete
Epoxy bonding adhesive (Roff/Fosroc/BASF) on chipped RCC/plaster
25 mm SBR polymer modified cement mortar 1:4 in 2 layers
3 mm APP modified five-layer waterproofing membrane
Repair to plaster in patches with polymer modified mortar
Acrylic emulsion paint, interior (two coats)
Premium acrylic smooth exterior paint with silicone additives
Synthetic enamel paint on old metal/wood/concrete surfaces
Taking out existing CC interlocking paver blocks
Cement concrete 1:2:4 in pavements
Relaying old CC interlocking paver blocks on 50 mm sand bed
Polyurethane floor paint over paver block pathway/road
18 mm black granite for kitchen platforms, vanity counters, sills
35 mm ISI flush door shutters
Taking out, repairing, painting and refixing door/window shutters
Polyethylene two-layer water storage tank ISI 12701 (Sintex/National/INFRA)
CPVC pipes 15/20/25/32 mm concealed and 40 mm exposed
110 mm uPVC rain water pipes with couplers, tees, bends, CI gratings
CP brass water supply fittings: bib cocks, stop cocks, angle valves, shower roses, couplings, wall mixers, jets, bottle traps, CPVC valves
Replacement of door/window fittings: sliding bolts, handles, hooks, tower bolts, butt hinges

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value (FDR/BG) before work order, released on satisfactory completion; plus 5% security deposit from each RA bill released after 6 months defect liability period
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST (BoQ total Rs 40,46,594.40). EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months; originals by 15/08/2025 16:00. MSME/NSIC bidders also required to submit EMD. Percentage-rate BoQ.

period.completion: 06 months from date of award of contract
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category with Central/State Govt/Municipal Corporation having tender limits >= estimated cost

Similar works (civil construction, repair and maintenance) in last 7 years: three works each >= Rs 16.18 lakh, or two each >= Rs 27.27 lakh, or one >= Rs 32.37 lakh (stated as 40%/60%/80%); sub-contractor experience not considered
Average annual turnover at least 30% of estimated cost (Rs 12,13,978) in last 3 financial years, CA certified
PAN, GST registration, ITRs for FY 2021-22 to 2023-24
Tender acceptance letter, unconditional-bid undertaking, bid securing declaration, notarised non-blacklisting affidavit, no-relatives declaration
Declaration under Official Secrets Act 1923 for secrecy of bid documents
Technical evaluation minimum 70/100: statutory 30, financial 20, experience 20, performance 20, key personnel 10
specs: Work per CPWD specifications; General Specifications for Civil Works (Section VI) including 53 grade OPC
Paints Asian/Berger/Shalimar/Indigo/Nerolac; PU floor paint Asian/Indigo/Dulux; epoxy Roff/Fosroc/BASF
uPVC windows EN 12608, IS 1367; FRP chajja IS 6746/IS 11551; APP membrane tested per ASTM D-5147; PU sealant ASTM C920
CPVC Astral/Prince/Finolex; CP fittings Jaquar/Parryware/Cera/Hindware; water tank ISI 12701 Sintex/National/INFRA
